SafariZone_West_Text_KogaPatrolsSafariEv:
The SAFARI ZONE's huge, wouldn't you say?
FUCHSIA's GYM LEADER, KOGA,  patrols the grounds every so often.
Thanks to him, we can play here knowing that we're safe.
SafariZone_West_Text_RocksMakeMonRunButE: Tossing ROCKS at POKéMON might make them run, but they'll be easier to catch.
SafariZone_West_Text_BaitMakesMonStickAr: Using BAIT will make POKéMON more likely to stick around if they get busy eating.
SafariZone_West_Text_HikedLotsDidntSeeMo: I hiked a lot, but I didn't see any POKéMON I wanted.
